syllabus_topics: Introduction. Basic equations. Friction losses. Basic calculations of pipes.
Calculation of pipes with pumps. Packed beds and columns.
Cake and bed filters. Settling velocity calculation.
Injection and blow moulding machines. Rolls and calenders.
Calculations of pipe and pipe networks.
Design calculations of cake and bed filters.
Settling velocity calculation. Design calculations of settlers and classifiers.
Design calculations of centrifuges and cyclones.
